findings.description: Use of exec to load version information from a trusted file in setup.py
findings.reasoning: The use of exec here is to load version information from a local, trusted file (__version__.py) during the package setup process. This is a common pattern in Python packaging and does not expose the exec function to untrusted input. The file being executed is part of the package source and not user-controlled, so there is no realistic risk of code injection in this context.
